newsitem.title: USA: Ciatti's tentative pricing on rights set.
newsitem.headline: Ciatti's tentative pricing on rights set.

text.p: Ciatti's Inc said on Tuesday the rights exercise price at which shareholders may buy additional shares was tentatively set at $3 per share.
In addition, the dates of the previously announced rights offering of its common stock were set. The record date will be October 22. The offering period will be November 1 through November 29.
The offering will be made to all company shareholders, with each holder receiving the right to buy two shares of common stock for every one share owned as of October 22.
Ciatti's intends to use proceeds to expand the number of its Bruegger's Bagel Bakery restaurants in the Dallas-Fort Worth, Texas area.
The company owns and operates a number of restaurants and bagel stores.
